title: Chapter 1: Echoes of Ash
intro: After the Great Outbreak, your coalition rises from the shattered cities. Every region you stabilize feeds your influence, but every harsh decision spreads fear.
primary_goal: Finish one run with at least 6 controlled regions and under 70 crisis.

milestones.description: End a run with crisis below 55.

epilogue: The coalition survives, but whispers of a rival doctrine surface beyond the northern arcologies.
